map.L1/L2 正则项计算器，输入权重向量求 L1 与 L2 范数及对应惩罚项，用于: L1/L2 regularization term calculator: enter a weight vector to get the L1 and L2 norms and the corresponding penalties, for understanding sparsifying and smoothing regularization effects.
map.两个范数量化权重矩阵的整体规模：L1 反映绝对值总量，对少量大权重敏感；L2（F: The two norms quantify the overall scale of a weight matrix: L1 reflects total absolute value and is sensitive to a few large weights; L2 (the Frobenius norm) reflects energy and is often written directly into the loss as a penalty. Tracking how the norm changes during training quickly shows whether weights are exploding.
map.L1 范数 ‖w‖₁=Σ|wᵢ|，L2 范数 ‖w‖₂=√(Σwᵢ²)，分别衡量: L1 norm ‖w‖₁ = Σ|wi|, L2 norm ‖w‖₂ = √(Σwi²), measuring weight magnitude respectively.
map.对应惩罚项 λ‖w‖₁(Lasso,促稀疏)与 (λ/2)‖w‖₂²(Ridge: Corresponding penalties are λ‖w‖₁ (Lasso, promotes sparsity) and (λ/2)‖w‖₂² (Ridge, promotes smoothness).
map.正则项加入损失函数，限制权重幅度以抑制过拟合。: The regularization term is added to the loss function to limit weight magnitude and curb overfitting.
map.：w=[3,−4]：‖w‖₁=|3|+|−4|=7；‖w‖₂=√(9+16)=5: : w = [3,−4]: ‖w‖₁ = |3| + |−4| = 7; ‖w‖₂ = √(9+16) = 5, L2 penalty = (λ/2)·25. L1 penalizes large weights equally, while L2 pushes harder on large weights.
map.L1 在零点不可导、等高线为菱形，最优解易落在坐标轴上使部分权重恰为 0，实现特: L1 is non-differentiable at zero and its contours are diamond shaped, so the optimum easily lands on an axis and some weights become exactly 0, achieving feature selection; L2 only shrinks and never zeroes.
map.正则系数 λ 怎么选？: How is the regularization coefficient λ chosen?
map.用验证集网格/贝叶斯搜索；λ 过小过拟合、过大欠拟合。通常对权重先标准化，再在: Use grid or Bayesian search on a validation set; too small λ overfits and too large underfits. Usually standardize the weights first, then scan the 10⁻⁴ to 10 range.
